notes: Extra cases for Self-RAG (S7), used with questions.json. chat = needs no book (right behaviour: no search, no pages). off_topic = the book can't answer (right behaviour: refuse, cite no pages). spoiler = an answerable question from questions.json asked while the reader is before its page (right behaviour: cite nothing past current_page).

How many goals did Lionel Messi score in 2022?
